# Rensley R. - doble196.github.io

> Founder of SebasTN Inc., New York. Full-stack engineer across AI, data
> science and blockchain: forecasting and scoring models, LLM assistants inside
> his apps, production web apps on AWS, and smart contracts live on four chains.

## What runs today

- [SebasTN Inc.](https://sebastn.com): the company.
- [Access0x1](https://access0x1.com): non-custodial payments network, live on Ethereum, Base, Unichain and Arc; proof at https://access0x1.com/mainnet.
- Uniswap v4 hooks: BoomerangHook takes 5% of liquidity-provider fees to the treasury on four chains; PayHook takes payment through a pool swap.
- [ClickReserv](https://clickreserv.com): booking, payments and point of sale for 200+ business types, on the business's own brand and domain.
- [Colmado](https://colmado.click): online orders and payments for bodegas and corner stores.
- [reserv.click](https://reserv.click): free short links and QR codes.
- [HemiAI](https://hemiai.click): brand events and giveaways, results recorded on chain.
